thread:
ida: New hire hitting a weird onboarding snag. `redwoodctl init` created a profile but `redwoodctl serve --local` still complains 'no active profile'. We're on corporate NFS home directories.

frank: NFS can cause file locking issues. Does `redwoodctl list-profiles` show the file? Check `stat ~/.config/redwoodctl/profiles.json` and whether it's a symlink.

ida: It's a symlink to `/nfs/home/ida/.redwood/profiles.json`. `redwoodctl init` said success but `list-profiles` returns empty. `strace` shows EIO when opening the symlinked file.

kayla: EIO on NFS often means stale filehandle; maybe the symlink was changed on the server after the inode moved. Try copying the file locally: `mkdir -p ~/.config/redwoodctl && cp /nfs/home/ida/.redwood/profiles.json ~/.config/redwoodctl/` then run `redwoodctl list-profiles`. If that fixes it we should document that we don't support symlinked profile files on NFS.

ida: Copying locally fixed `list-profiles`. But now `redwoodctl login` starts device-code flow and the CLI prints: `token cache locked: access denied` occasionally. Looks like the antivirus on Windows client is locking the cache when the browser callback writes the token file.

frank: Interesting combo: NFS symlink + Windows AV. For local dev we should prefer XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointing to a non-NFS path. Recommend `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config_local` in quickstart for folks with network homes. Also add a note to exclude the token cache path from AV scanning.

kayla: Also add a fallback env var `REDWOODCTL_PROFILE` the quickstart can set, because many of our samples assume `default` and that trips people who name custom profiles. We'll also add an explicit `redwoodctl activate --profile <name>` step in the sample.

ida: One more oddity: when multiple team members use the same NFS-backed profile file, token refreshes collide and some clients get `invalid_grant`. We should warn users not to share a profiles.json across users.

devex-bot: Created docs ticket #4011: "CLI onboarding: NFS symlink pitfalls, XDG_CONFIG_HOME fallback, AV exclusions, and shared profile warnings" assigned to @kayla :spiral_note_pad:

frank: I'll draft a short support note and add a checklist to the quickstart. Thanks for the repro, Ida.

ida: Thanks all — local copy + AV exclusion made onboarding work. :thumbsup:
